datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2013 across Niger administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases (IPC 1-5 scale) under different scenarios, spatially encoded as geographic features with temporal metadata (collection date, period date, scenario type) to enable temporal and spatial analysis of food security conditions.
